XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light comes on, with properly running vehicle
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0638 | P0530 | P0402 | PERFORMS | LOSES | DROPS | MISSES | POWER | SPEED | DROP | SWITCHES ON | ON | MIL | YELLOW |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Motorised throttle body

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated, with loss of performance

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P0638 (Throttle actuator control, bank 1 – Incorrect operating range)
  • P0530 (Air conditioning pressure sensor - Generic fault)
  • P0402 (Exhaust gas recirculation - High value)
  • Cause: Faulty motorised throttle body

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the throttle body and, if necessary, clean or replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, in addition to replacing the motorised throttle body, the associated wiring connected to the throttle body was also replaced/added, thereby permanently resolving the fault.
    The faulty component showed no visible defects and, following its replacement, no reprogramming using diagnostic equipment was required.

    Problems with this component are quite common on this engine.
    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 1.3 hours.
